threads.body: [General] This generated change replaces the published stable common flat property and declarative key (`otel.instrumentation.messaging.batch-send.message-creation-spans.enabled` / `java.common.messaging.batch_send.message_creation_spans.enabled`) during the 2.32 cycle. Neither old name is marked experimental or preview, and the repository no longer contains a fallback for either, so configurations that worked with 2.31 will silently revert to the default. Keep the old names as deprecated aliases until 3.0, use replacement-first fallback with a warning when an old value is applied, add the required deprecation note, and then regenerate this file rather than editing it directly.
